mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.

City officials announced that chip seal road treatments begin September 23, impacting areas including Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects on October 5, and the city continues to implement goals from the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can join trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing Co. or Lake Lou-ee, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Bogey Factory on September 23. Don't forget the popular Verona Fall Fest on September 25.
Regarding recent activity, on September 5, an officer located several vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a viral social media prank, which resulted in no damage.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
